object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Define an integer attribute; in the grid editor and the Inspector, try `42`, `-7`, an empty value, `3.14` and `abc`. Expected: the first three are accepted and stored; the last two can't be entered or are refused, and no file changes. Define a real attribute; try `3.14`, `-2`, an empty value, `abc` and `1.2.3`. Expected: the first three are stored; the last two can't be entered or are refused. Define a date attribute; enter 0001-01-01, 9999-12-31 and an empty value, and try 0000-12-31 and 10000-01-01. Expected: the first three are stored; the last two can't be entered.
